description: This file defines the TaskSchedulerLog entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the database table 'ohrm_task_scheduler_log' and includes properties for log details such as ID, start and finish times, command executed, input data, and status. It also provides setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for scheduled tasks in the system. Contains properties for execution details and timing, with database mapping annotations.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: setStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the start time when the task was initiated.

methods.name: setFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the finish time when the task completed.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Sets the command executed by the scheduler.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input parameters for the command, stored as JSON.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the task execution.
